profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Salient Motion
profile.summary: Specialties: open-source software, Ruby on or off the Rails, Video, AWS (Amazon Web Services), Linux, Rust, Python, JavaScript & Node.js, cryptocurrencies, and above all, fixing the tough software problems.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Los Angeles, California, United States · Remote

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
Experian Consumer Services: Aug '22 -- Feb '24:

-   Worked with a mixed team of Experian and West Monroe colleagues to
    maintain and add features to Gabi, an insurance
    marketplace previously acquired by Experian.

-   Most of the work involved a very large (~200k SLOC) Ruby on Rails
    web app with a smaller accompanying React/TypeScript app. This app
    was used by sales agents to complete purchases and assist customers
    in various ways.

-   Primary new feature added was API integration with a third party
    workforce management solution to track sales agent activity to
    better allocate sales agent shifts to match customer demand.

-   Added Qualtrics integration, allowing sales agents and customer
    service team members to view survey feedback from customers on their
    internal profiles.

-   Identified root cause of a failure in connections to an
    internal but cross-team API for auto data, which was due
    to outdated TLS settings. Worked with mgmt. to get that
    team to update their settings, restoring connectivity.

Zenimax Online Services (now part of Xbox, and Microsoft): July '18
- April '22:

-   Worked with 3 other engineers on a long-term project to
    migrate a large Python codebase to Go, and containerize it. Game client communicated with this server
    for miscellaneous purposes including reward delivery, virtual
    currency mgmt., and routing to the appropriate game realm.

-   Created Go library packages to support storing ephemeral data in
    Redis rather than Memcached, with config options to fallback to
    Memcached at deployment time.

-   Part of PagerDuty rotation for prod support when Ops
    team was unable to resolve issue.

-   Clearly documented release steps and rollback procedures for
    Ops team.

-   Lead developer for improvements to their Xbox subscription system,
    coordinating with company's contact at Microsoft

-   Delivered fixes to virtual currency and Twitch reward systems

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
As a member of a small rapid response team for a white-label Internet TV platform,

* I identified the underlying cause of problems affecting end users (often more than 100k of them).
* I provided end-to-end support to the customer.
* I developed solutions for the problems, including any relevant unit and integration tests.
* I worked with the DevOps team to ensure the solution is put in place and functioning correctly

Technologies used: MySQL, AWS DynamoDB & S3 & EC2 & CloudSearch, Redis, Ruby on Rails, Kibana, Wireshark, SDKs for numerous video streaming and mobile devices

positions.title: Full Stack Software Developer
positions.description:
Wrote and maintained the Node.js server for a mobile app to track personal fitness and nutrition with a sophisticated ability to track workouts and operate with limited Internet connectivity.

Collaborated with the Android and iOS teams (primarily by providing documentation and SQLite queries).

Worked with the UX team to understand the needed technical capabilities, and to explain what was possible within a given time frame.

App supports trainers logging workouts on behalf of members, and observing their workout histories (including personal records).

Implemented a new assessment system to support health questionnaires with complex dependencies among the questions.

Improved integration with wearable health devices (e.g., Fitbit).

Assisted in adding server­-side support for a desktop (web­-based) interface.

positions.title: VP, Engineering
positions.description:
Developed backend, and maintained infrastructure for a small mobile app startup

- used nginx as a reverse proxy, for performance and flexibility
- ported some endpoints over to Node.JS from Ruby on Rails
- by doing so, the search endpoint was sped up by a factor of ~100
- moved app from Heroku to DigitalOcean, resulting in better performance at a lower price
- added HTTPS support

Collaborated with and supervised remote iOS developers
Informed potential investors of technical aspects of the app

positions.title: Backend Engineer
positions.description:
Numerous bug fixes to the backend; in particular, one of these caused 90% of users' photo posts (“moments”) to not be visible.
Produced Node.js tools to find and correct data inconsistencies:

- assign stock male/female photos to User documents in MongoDB lacking photos
- delete any photos from Amazon S3 not referenced by any User document

Participated in the design of a graph data model to use for the Neo4j graph database.
Using the above data model, designed an asynchronous data access layer for accessing Neo4j via its REST API.
Developed a tool to migrate data from MongoDB into Neo4j, with the additional purpose of performance testing Neo4j.
Developed the backend of a photo moderation web app allowing third-party workers to quickly review user photos, flagging those that are inappropriate.
Setup a local development environment in a virtual machine for use by the rest of the Backend team.

positions.title: C/Perl/Python Programmer
positions.description: Developed Python tools to manipulate video files (cutting to frame boundary incl. audio tracks, joining files together, etc.); maintained several large Perl scripts and C programs; developed Python script to securely run commands and transfer files on dozens of remote Linux and OS X machines in parallel using SSH.

positions.title: programming - contract work
positions.description: Modifications to the PyGame and SDL-Mixer open-source libraries to allow python apps to seek within audio playback channels; enhancements to the user interface of Audacity, a widely used open-source audio editor, so that audio metadata can be manipulated in a graphical manner (cut, copy, paste, align, drag, or distribute); worked on the development of an educational music-related game utilizing the Unity game engine for Macs and iPhones; for said game development, set up and maintained a private Subversion repository using SASL encryption for all data transfers

positions.title: lab technician
positions.description:
I worked on basic research into an electrochemical effect to be used in a medical diagnostic device‭; ‬it would report on levels of a particular metabolic chemical in the patient's blood.‭  ‬Thus,‭ ‬this device would assist in treating said patient.

In the course of this research, I wrote several small Python apps to assist in testing and analyzing data from Keithley 2400 multimeters. I also corrected bugs in the software driving the multimeter.

educations.schoolName: The University of Texas at Dallas
